# Client events and attributes

Generated from the source by `scripts/gen-reference.mjs`; do not edit by hand. The DOM events Nowaki's client code dispatches and the attributes it reads, from `api/client.txt` (a scan of `packages/nowaki-runtime/client`).

## Island directives

Put one on an island element in a page or layout to choose when it hydrates. Typed for JSX by the scaffold's `nowaki-jsx.d.ts`.

| Directive | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `client:load` | `boolean` | Hydrate on page load (default). |
| `client:idle` | `boolean` | Hydrate when idle, via requestIdleCallback. |
| `client:visible` | `boolean` | Hydrate once visible, via IntersectionObserver. |
| `client:media` | `string` | Hydrate when the media query matches. e.g. client:media="(min-width: 768px)" |
| `client:only` | `boolean` | Skip SSR and render on the client only (for islands using browser-only APIs). |

## Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `nowaki:action` | Dispatched (bubbling) on a `<form action={serverFn}>` after the server function answered. `detail`: `{ id, ok, result, error }`. |
| `nowaki:live-error` | Dispatched on `window` when a live island event was not applied (the island keeps its last HTML). `detail`: `{ nid, reason }`; `reason` is a short string such as `stale`, `busy` or `forbidden`. |
| `nowaki:live-stale` | Dispatched on `window` (cancelable) when a live island's signed state is older than `NOWAKI_LIVE_MAX_AGE`. The page reloads unless a listener calls `preventDefault()`. `detail`: `{ nid }`. |
| `nowaki:page-load` | Dispatched on `document` after the client router has swapped in a new page and hydrated its islands (not on the first, full page load). `detail`: `{ url, timing }`, plus `slot` (the slot name) when only an intercepting slot was replaced. |
| `nowaki:presence` | Dispatched on `window` when the number of live connections changes. `detail`: `{ count, room }` (`room` is set for a room island's members). |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `data-live` | Inside a live island: a click on the element sends the event named by the value to the island's `live.on` handler, with the element's `value` (if any) as the payload. |
| `data-live-change` | Inside a live island: sends the named event when the field's value is committed (blur, select, checkbox). Checkboxes and radios send `{ value, checked }`, other fields their value. |
| `data-live-debounce` | Milliseconds `data-live-input` waits after the last keystroke. Default `150`. |
| `data-live-input` | Inside a live island: sends the named event while the user types (debounced, see `data-live-debounce`), with the field's value. |
| `data-live-submit` | On a `<form>` inside a live island: submitting it sends the named event with the form's fields as an object, without navigating. |
| `data-nowaki-error` | In `error.tsx`: the element the client router writes the failed navigation's error message into. |
| `data-nowaki-presence` | An element whose text the live runtime keeps set to the number of live connections: `""` counts every connection, a room id counts that room's members. |
| `data-nowaki-reset` | In `error.tsx`: a click on this element retries the failed navigation. |
| `data-nowaki-transition` | On an `<a>` or an element around links: client navigations from those links run as View Transitions. `<Link viewTransition>` renders it. |

Slot elements: a layout's `slots.<name>` renders inside `<nowaki-slot name="<name>">` (`display: contents`); the `name` attribute is stable, for styling. See [LayoutProps](runtime.md#layoutprops).

## Not covered

Dev-only events: `nowaki:hmr`, `nowaki:toolbar`, `nowaki:toolbar-ui`. Internal attributes of generated markup: `data-live-connections`, `data-live-transport`, `data-nowaki-attrs`, `data-nowaki-css`, `data-nowaki-head`, `data-nowaki-intercepts`, `data-nowaki-script`, `data-nowaki-slot`. The `<nowaki-island>` / `<nowaki-live>` elements and `window.__nowaki*` globals are internal too.
